messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting v2 rollout in ~20m (quiet window). Can people be on-call for the first 30m? :eyes: Ramp plan 10% -> 50% over 15m. Release notes pushed: https://go/release-notes/v2. Watch mobile clients (older SDKs + header-case).

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: v2 -> 10% traffic at 1819990120. Canary ID: canary-1819. Logs -> #eng-monitoring. :robot_face:

aj: I'll be on. Can we add a temporary client-pin for SDKs <12.4.0? Last time header-case bit us.

ken: Rollback trigger proposal: 5m error rate >0.5% OR p95 latency +200ms. Automated rollback to v1 for affected shard if hit.

sara: Quick FYI — tests just tripped a schema variant in embeddings path (chat -> embedding). Low repro but filing a flag anyway.

maria: Ok add pin command to runbook: `deploybot pin client sdk-version <12.4.0` and patch release notes line about header case.

deploy-bot: canary started: v2 @10% -> 1819990120
metrics snapshot: 5m_errors=0.08%, p95=120ms, request_rate=210rps

logbot: sampled error: `json_schema_mismatch: field 'conversation.history' expected list got null` from tenant tera-2048 (trace ea3f2c9).

aj: that matches sara's schema find. Can we back off mobile shard to 5%?

maria: Pump the brakes — lowering to 5% for mobile region eu-west-1. Run: `deploybot reroute canary-1819 --shard mobile-eu --pct 5`

deploy-bot: reroute accepted. mobile-eu now at 5%.

deploy-bot: alert: 5m_errors increased to 0.6% at recent window :warning:

ken: triggering rollback per rule. Initiating rollback to v1 for canary-1819.

ops-run: starting rollback: `deploybot rollback canary-1819 --to v1 --force`

deploy-bot: rollback succeeded. Traffic now 100% v1 for canary-1819. Took 72s. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks — we'll hold the rollout. Update release notes with mitigation + pin instructions, and schedule a short postmortem if we get more repros.

sara: I'll add a prompt/test set to catch this schema, opening ticket RUN-3256 and linking it to the canary logs.

aj: +1 on pinning older SDKs until mobile-ops confirms. I'll take ownership with mobile-ops.

maria: Plan: rebaseline canary to 5% steady for 24h then reattempt progressive ramp if stable. Ops handback scheduled in ~10m.

deploy-bot: note: operator handback scheduled at 1819990500. :calendar:
